title: AgentDock release-candidate evidence manifest
description: Schema for the manifest produced by .github/workflows/release-candidate.yml (issue #66). See docs/release-checklist.md for what a 'ready' manifest does and does not prove.

dirty.description: True if the checkout that produced this manifest had uncommitted changes -- a dirty manifest must never be read as describing a specific, reproducible commit.

ready.description: True only when every entry in `gates` passed. Never set directly -- always the strict AND of `gates[].passed`, computed by aggregateGateResults() in manifest.mjs.

published.description: This workflow never publishes a release. Always false; there is no code path that can flip it.

documentedExceptions.description: Known, already-documented exceptions this candidate carries (e.g. the electron-builder dev-tool audit advisories in docs/packaging.md#current-dependency-audit-exception), so a reviewer doesn't have to rediscover them.

available.description: False when issue #65's live-provider-smoke evidence file wasn't found for this run -- a missing matrix must read as 'not verified', never as an implicit pass.

verified.description: True only when resultCode is exactly 'success'. A skip or a failure is never 'verified', even though the row is still present.

sbom.description: Software bill of materials for this candidate (issue #61), generated by anchore/sbom-action in CycloneDX format. `available: false` means it wasn't generated for this run -- never an implicit claim about what the release actually contains.

provenance.description: Build provenance attestation for this candidate's installer artifact (issue #61), generated by actions/attest-build-provenance. `available: false` means no attestation was generated for this run.
